demo.title: From Partial Fill to Accounting: Where Do the 30 Units Go?

scope: Derived scoped event projection over seven retained local Foundry EVM observations and observed token transfers; no public-chain execution or complete economic accounting.
unmet_request_disposition: Unmet request only; no deferred entitlement, funded liability, recognized loss, cancellation right or future obligation is created by this fixture.
qualification_boundary: Initiator-specified source; local test token and local Foundry EVM observations, not public-chain receipts or cryptographic state proofs.

unmet_request_decomposition.equation: 30 unmet = 20 not deposited against requests + 10 deposited but protected
unmet_request_decomposition.assumption: The fixture’s 80-unit deposit is the complete source capital for these requests; its configured 10-unit protected floor is excluded from allocation. This does not qualify the floor’s beneficial owner, purpose or release/refund authority.

intermediate_states.note: Seven retained call-boundary observations remain primary; they end at allocator closure, and final reserve settlement is not observed.

protected_capital_policy.enforcement: Carol attribution is declared by fixture policy; rights are neither independently proven nor contract-enforced by reserve V2.
